NAME
====

eza — a modern replacement for ls


SYNOPSIS
========

`eza [options] [files...]`

**eza** is a modern replacement for `ls`.
It uses colours for information by default, helping you distinguish between many types of files, such as whether you are the owner, or in the owning group.

It also has extra features not present in the original `ls`, such as viewing the Git status for a directory, or recursing into directories with a tree view.


EXAMPLES
========

`eza`
: Lists the contents of the current directory in a grid.

`eza --oneline --reverse --sort=size`
: Displays a list of files with the largest at the top.

`eza --long --header --inode --git`
: Displays a table of files with a header, showing each file’s metadata, inode, and Git status.

`eza --long --tree --level=3`
: Displays a tree of files, three levels deep, as well as each file’s metadata.


META OPTIONS
===============

`--help`
: Show list of command-line options.

`-v`, `--version`
: Show version of eza.

DISPLAY OPTIONS
===============

`-1`, `--oneline`
: Display one entry per line.

`--absolute=WHEN`
: Display entries with their absolute path.

Valid settings are '`on`', '`follow`', and '`off`'.
When used without a value, defaults to '`on`'.

'`on`': Show absolute paths for all entries.
'`follow`': Show absolute paths and resolve symbolic links to their targets.
'`off`': Show relative paths (default behavior).

`-F`, `--classify=WHEN`
: Display file kind indicators next to file names.

Valid settings are ‘`always`’, ‘`automatic`’ (or ‘`auto`’ for short), and ‘`never`’.
When used without a value, defaults to ‘`automatic`’.

`automatic` or `auto` will display file kind indicators only when the standard output is connected to a real terminal. If `eza` is ran while in a `tty`, or the output of `eza` is either redirected to a file or piped into another program, file kind indicators will not be used. Setting this option to ‘`always`’ causes `eza` to always display file kind indicators, while ‘`never`’ disables the use of file kind indicators.

`-G`, `--grid`
: Display entries as a grid (default).

`-l`, `--long`
: Display extended file metadata as a table.

`-R`, `--recurse`
: Recurse into directories.

`-T`, `--tree`
: Recurse into directories as a tree.

`--follow-symlinks`
: Drill down into symbolic links that point to directories.

`-X`, `--dereference`
: Dereference symbolic links when displaying information.

`-x`, `--across`
: Sort the grid across, rather than downwards.

`--color=WHEN`, `--colour=WHEN`
: When to use terminal colours (using ANSI escape code to colorize the output).

Valid settings are ‘`always`’, ‘`automatic`’ (or ‘`auto`’ for short), and ‘`never`’.
When used without a value, defaults to ‘`automatic`’.

The default behavior (‘`automatic`’ or ‘`auto`’) is to colorize the output only when the standard output is connected to a real terminal. If the output of `eza` is redirected to a file or piped into another program, terminal colors will not be used. Setting this option to ‘`always`’ causes `eza` to always output terminal color, while ‘`never`’ disables the use of terminal color.

Manually setting this option overrides `NO_COLOR` environment.

`--color-scale`, `--colour-scale`
: highlight levels of `field` distinctly.
Use comma(,) separated list of all, age, size

`--color-scale-mode=MODE`, `--colour-scale-mode=MODE`
: Use gradient or fixed colors in `--color-scale`.

Valid options are `fixed` or `gradient`.
When used without a value, defaults to `gradient`.

`--icons=WHEN`
: Display icons next to file names.

Valid settings are ‘`always`’, ‘`automatic`’ (‘`auto`’ for short), and ‘`never`’.
When used without a value, defaults to ‘`automatic`’.

`automatic` or `auto` will display icons only when the standard output is connected to a real terminal. If `eza` is ran while in a `tty`, or the output of `eza` is either redirected to a file or piped into another program, icons will not be used. Setting this option to ‘`always`’ causes `eza` to always display icons, while ‘`never`’ disables the use of icons.

`--no-quotes`
: Don't quote file names with spaces.

`--hyperlink`
: Display entries as hyperlinks

`-w`, `--width=COLS`
: Set screen width in columns.

FILTERING AND SORTING OPTIONS
=============================

`-a`, `--all`
: Show hidden and “dot” files.
Use this twice to also show the ‘`.`’ and ‘`..`’ directories.

`-A`, `--almost-all`
: Equivalent to --all; included for compatibility with `ls -A`.

`-d`, `--treat-dirs-as-files`
: This flag, inherited from `ls`, changes how `eza` handles directory arguments.

: Instead of recursing into directories and listing their contents (the default behavior), it treats directories as regular files and lists information about the directory entry itself.

: This is useful when you want to see metadata about the directory (e.g., permissions, size, modification time) rather than its contents.

: For simply listing only directories and not files, consider using the `--only-dirs` (`-D`) option as an alternative.

`-L`, `--level=DEPTH`
: Limit the depth of recursion.

`-r`, `--reverse`
: Reverse the sort order.

`-s`, `--sort=SORT_FIELD`
: Which field to sort by.

Valid sort fields are ‘`name`’, ‘`Name`’, ‘`extension`’, ‘`Extension`’, ‘`size`’, ‘`modified`’, ‘`changed`’, ‘`accessed`’, ‘`created`’, ‘`inode`’, ‘`type`’, and ‘`none`’.

The `modified` sort field has the aliases ‘`date`’, ‘`time`’, and ‘`newest`’, and its reverse order has the aliases ‘`age`’ and ‘`oldest`’.

Sort fields starting with a capital letter will sort uppercase before lowercase: ‘A’ then ‘B’ then ‘a’ then ‘b’. Fields starting with a lowercase letter will mix them: ‘A’ then ‘a’ then ‘B’ then ‘b’.

`-I`, `--ignore-glob=GLOBS`
: Glob patterns, pipe-separated, of files to ignore.

`--git-ignore` [if eza was built with git support]
: Do not list files that are ignored by Git.

`--group-directories-first`
: List directories before other files.

`--group-directories-last`
: List directories after other files.

`-D`, `--only-dirs`
: List only directories, not files.

`-f`, `--only-files`
: List only files, not directories.

`--show-symlinks`
: Explicitly show symbolic links (when used with `--only-files` | `--only-dirs`)

`--no-symlinks`
: Do not show symbolic links

LONG VIEW OPTIONS
=================

These options are available when running with `--long` (`-l`):

`-b`, `--binary`
: List file sizes with binary prefixes.

`-B`, `--bytes`
: List file sizes in bytes, without any prefixes.

`--changed`
: Use the changed timestamp field.

`-g`, `--group`
: List each file’s group.

`--smart-group`
: Only show group if it has a different name from owner

`-h`, `--header`
: Add a header row to each column.

`-H`, `--links`
: List each file’s number of hard links.

`-i`, `--inode`
: List each file’s inode number.

`-m`, `--modified`
: Use the modified timestamp field.

`-M`, `--mounts`
: Show mount details (Linux and Mac only)

`-n`, `--numeric`
: List numeric user and group IDs.

`-O`, `--flags`
: List file flags on Mac and BSD systems and file attributes on Windows systems.  By default, Windows attributes are displayed in a long form.  To display in attributes as single character set the environment variable `EZA_WINDOWS_ATTRIBUTES=short`.  On BSD systems see chflags(1) for a list of file flags and their meanings.

`-S`, `--blocksize`
: List each file’s size of allocated file system blocks.

`-t`, `--time=WORD`
: Which timestamp field to list.

: Valid timestamp fields are ‘`modified`’, ‘`changed`’, ‘`accessed`’, and ‘`created`’.

`--time-style=STYLE`
: How to format timestamps.

: Valid timestamp styles are ‘`default`’, ‘`iso`’, ‘`long-iso`’, ‘`full-iso`’, ‘`relative`’, or a custom style ‘`+<FORMAT>`’ (e.g., ‘`+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M`’ => ‘`2023-09-30 13:00`’).

`<FORMAT>` should be a chrono format string.  For details on the chrono format syntax, please read: https://docs.rs/chrono/latest/chrono/format/strftime/index.html .

Alternatively, `<FORMAT>` can be a two line string, the first line will be used for non-recent files and the second for recent files.  E.g., if `<FORMAT>` is "`%Y-%m-%d %H<newline>--%m-%d %H:%M`", non-recent files => "`2022-12-30 13`", recent files => "`--09-30 13:34`".

`--total-size`
: Show recursive directory size (unix only).

`-u`, `--accessed`
: Use the accessed timestamp field.

`-U`, `--created`
: Use the created timestamp field.

`--no-permissions`
: Suppress the permissions field.

`-o`, `--octal-permissions`
"}

+    def has(self, name: str) -> bool:
+        return any(spec.long == name and val is None for _, val, spec in self.flags)
+
+    def count(self, name: str) -> int:
+        return sum(1 for _, _, spec in self.flags if spec.long == name)
+
+    def get(self, *names: str) -> str | None:
+        for _, val, spec in reversed(self.flags):
+            if spec.long in names and val is not None:
+                return val
+        return None
+
+    def last_flag(self, *names: str) -> str | None:
+        for _, val, spec in reversed(self.flags):
+            if spec.long in names and val is None:
+                return spec.long
+        return None

+def flag_text(spec: ArgSpec, typed: str) -> str:
+    if typed.startswith("--"):
+        return "--" + spec.long
+    return "-" + (spec.short or spec.long)

+def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> Options | str:
+    opt = Options()
+    i = 0
+    parsing = True
+    while i < len(argv):
+        arg = argv[i]
+        i += 1
+        if not parsing:
+            opt.paths.append(arg)
+            continue
+        if arg == "--":
+            parsing = False
+            continue
+        if arg.startswith("--") and arg != "--":
+            body = arg[2:]
+            if "=" in body:
+                name, val = body.split("=", 1)
+            else:
+                name, val = body, None
+            spec = LONG.get(name)
+            if not spec:
+                raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument --{name}")
+            if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                if val is not None:
+                    raise EzaError(f"Flag --{spec.long} cannot take a value")
+                opt.flags.append(("--" + name, None, spec))
+            elif spec.takes == "necessary":
+                if val is None:
+                    if i >= len(argv):
+                        suffix = choices_text(spec) if spec.values else ""
+                        raise EzaError(f"Flag --{spec.long} needs a value{suffix}")
+                    val = argv[i]
+                    i += 1
+                opt.flags.append(("--" + name, val, spec))
+            else:
+                if val is None:
+                    if i < len(argv) and argv[i] in spec.values:
+                        val = argv[i]
+                        i += 1
+                    else:
+                        val = spec.default
+                opt.flags.append(("--" + name, val, spec))
+            continue
+        if arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
+            body = arg[1:]
+            if "=" in body:
+                before, val = body.split("=", 1)
+                if before == "":
+                    opt.paths.append(arg)
+                    continue
+                for ch in before[:-1]:
+                    spec = SHORT.get(ch)
+                    if not spec:
+                        raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                    if spec.takes != "forbidden":
+                        if spec.takes == "optional":
+                            opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, spec.default, spec))
+                        else:
+                            raise EzaError(f"Flag -{ch} needs a value{choices_text(spec) if spec.values else ''}")
+                    else:
+                        opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, None, spec))
+                ch = before[-1]
+                spec = SHORT.get(ch)
+                if not spec:
+                    raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    raise EzaError(f"Flag -{ch} cannot take a value")
+                opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, val, spec))
+                continue
+            j = 0
+            while j < len(body):
+                ch = body[j]
+                spec = SHORT.get(ch)
+                if not spec:
+                    raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, None, spec))
+                    j += 1
+                elif spec.takes == "necessary":
+                    if j < len(body) - 1:
+                        val = body[j + 1:]
+                    else:
+                        if i >= len(argv):
+                            raise EzaError(f"Flag -{ch} needs a value{choices_text(spec) if spec.values else ''}")
+                        val = argv[i]
+                        i += 1
+                    opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, val, spec))
+                    break
+                else:
+                    if j < len(body) - 1:
+                        val = body[j + 1:]
+                        if val not in spec.values:
+                            raise EzaError(f"Flag -{ch} cannot take a value")
+                    elif i < len(argv) and argv[i] in spec.values:
+                        val = argv[i]
+                        i += 1
+                    else:
+                        val = spec.default
+                    opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, val, spec))
+                    break
+            continue
+        opt.paths.append(arg)
+
+    if opt.has("help"):
+        return "help"
+    if opt.has("version"):
+        return "version"
+    deduce_options(opt)
+    return opt

+def choices_text(spec: ArgSpec) -> str:
+    if not spec.values:
+        return ""
+    return " (choices: " + ", ".join(spec.values) + ")"
+
+
+def bad_arg(spec: ArgSpec, value: str) -> EzaError:
+    if spec.takes == "necessary" and spec.values:
+        return EzaError(f"Option --{spec.long}" + (f" (-{spec.short})" if spec.short else "") + f" has no {value!r} setting{choices_text(spec)}")
+    return EzaError(f"Option --{spec.long}" + (f" (-{spec.short})" if spec.short else "") + f" has no {value!r} setting")
+
+
+def deduce_options(opt: Options) -> None:
+    for _, val, spec in opt.flags:
+        if val is not None and spec.values and spec.takes == "necessary" and val not in spec.values:
+            if spec.long == "time-style" and val.startswith("+"):
+                continue
+            raise bad_arg(spec, val)
+        if val is not None and spec.takes == "optional" and spec.values and val not in spec.values:
+            raise bad_arg(spec, val)
+    width = opt.get("width")
+    if width is not None:
+        try:
+            opt.width = int(width)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise EzaError(f"Value {width!r} not valid for option --width (-w): {e}")
+    level = opt.get("level")
+    if level is not None:
+        try:
+            opt.max_depth = int(level, 10)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise EzaError(f"Value {level!r} not valid for option --level (-L): {e}")
+    sort = opt.get("sort")
+    if sort is not None:
+        aliases = {"filename": "name", "Filename": "Name", "ext": "extension", "Ext": "Extension", "filesize": "size", "date": "modified", "time": "modified", "mod": "modified", "new": "modified", "newest": "modified", "age": "oldest", "old": "oldest", "ch": "changed", "acc": "accessed", "cr": "created"}
+        opt.sort = aliases.get(sort, sort)
+        if opt.sort.startswith("."):
+            opt.sort = opt.sort[1:]
+        if opt.sort not in SORT_CHOICES and opt.sort != "oldest":
+            raise bad_arg(LONG["sort"], sort)
+    time_kind = opt.get("time")
+    if time_kind is not None:
+        opt.time_kind = time_kind
+    if opt.has("modified"):
+        opt.time_kind = "modified"
+    if opt.has("accessed"):
+        opt.time_kind = "accessed"
+    if opt.has("created"):
+        opt.time_kind = "created"
+    if opt.has("changed"):
+        opt.time_kind = "changed"
+    ts = opt.get("time-style")
+    if ts is not None:
+        opt.time_style = ts
+    opt.all_count = opt.count("all")
+    opt.almost_all = opt.has("almost-all")
+    opt.reverse = opt.has("reverse")
+    opt.dirs_first = opt.has("group-directories-first")
+    opt.dirs_last = opt.has("group-directories-last")
+    opt.only_dirs = opt.has("only-dirs")
+    opt.only_files = opt.has("only-files")
+    opt.no_symlinks = opt.has("no-symlinks")
+    opt.show_symlinks = opt.has("show-symlinks")
+    ig = opt.get("ignore-glob")
+    opt.ignore_globs = ig.split("|") if ig else []
+    opt.across = opt.has("across")
+    opt.as_file = opt.has("treat-dirs-as-files") or opt.has("list-dirs")
+    opt.recurse = opt.has("recurse") or opt.has("tree")
+    opt.tree = opt.has("tree")
+    opt.stdin = opt.has("stdin") or not sys.stdin.isatty()
+    opt.classify = opt.get("classify") or "never"
+    if opt.classify == "auto" and not sys.stdout.isatty():
+        opt.classify = "never"
+    opt.icons = opt.get("icons") or "never"
+    if opt.icons == "auto" and not (sys.stdout.isatty() or os.environ.get("EZA_ICONS_AUTO")):
+        opt.icons = "never"
+    opt.color = opt.get("color", "colour") or "auto"
+    if opt.color == "auto" and not sys.stdout.isatty():
+        opt.color = "never"
+    opt.absolute = opt.get("absolute") or "off"
+    opt.no_quotes = opt.has("no-quotes")
+    opt.long_header = opt.has("header")
+    opt.permissions = not opt.has("no-permissions")
+    opt.filesize = not opt.has("no-filesize")
+    opt.user = not opt.has("no-user")
+    opt.group = opt.has("group") or opt.has("smart-group")
+    opt.links = opt.has("links")
+    opt.inode = opt.has("inode")
+    opt.blocksize = opt.has("blocksize")
+    opt.file_flags = opt.has("flags")
+    opt.time = not opt.has("no-time")
+    if opt.has("bytes"):
+        opt.size_format = "bytes"
+    elif opt.has("binary"):
+        opt.size_format = "binary"
+    view_flag = None
+    for _, val, spec in reversed(opt.flags):
+        if val is None and spec.long in {"long", "oneline", "grid", "tree"}:
+            view_flag = spec.long
+            break
+    if view_flag == "long" or (view_flag in {"tree", "grid"} and opt.has("long")):
+        opt.mode = "long"
+    elif view_flag == "grid":
+        opt.mode = "grid"
+    elif view_flag == "tree":
+        opt.mode = "long"
+    else:
+        opt.mode = "lines" if not sys.stdout.isatty() else "grid"
+    if view_flag == "oneline":
+        opt.mode = "lines"

+@dataclass
+class Entry:
+    path: Path
+    display_arg: str | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def name(self) -> str:
+        return self.path.name or str(self.path)
+
+    def is_dir(self) -> bool:
+        return self.path.is_dir()
+
+    def is_file(self) -> bool:
+        return self.path.is_file()
+
+    def stat(self):
+        return self.path.stat()
+
+
+def win_error_for_missing(path: str) -> str:
+    return f'"{path}": 系统找不到指定的文件。 (os error 2)'
+
+
+def path_exists(p: Path) -> bool:
+    try:
+        return p.exists() or p.is_symlink()
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+
+
+def children_of(path: Path, opt: Options) -> list[Entry]:
+    out = []
+    try:
+        for child in path.iterdir():
+            name = child.name
+            if not show_dot(name, opt):
+                continue
+            if any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, pat) for pat in opt.ignore_globs):
+                continue
+            ent = Entry(child)
+            if opt.no_symlinks and child.is_symlink():
+                continue
+            if opt.only_dirs and not ent.is_dir():
+                continue
+            if opt.only_files and ent.is_dir():
+                continue
+            out.append(ent)
+    except PermissionError:
+        raise
+    return sort_entries(out, opt)
+
+
+def show_dot(name: str, opt: Options) -> bool:
+    if name in {".", ".."}:
+        return opt.all_count >= 2
+    if name.startswith("."):
+        return opt.all_count >= 1 or opt.almost_all
+    return True
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries: list[Entry], opt: Options) -> list[Entry]:
+    if opt.sort == "none":
+        seq = entries[:]
+    else:
+        def key(e: Entry):
+            try:
+                st = e.stat()
+            except OSError:
+                st = None
+            name = e.name
+            if opt.sort in {"name", "Name"}:
+                return (name.lower(), name) if opt.sort == "name" else (name,)
+            if opt.sort in {"extension", "Extension"}:
+                ext = (Path(name).suffix[1:] if Path(name).suffix else "").lower()
+                return (ext, name.lower(), name)
+            if opt.sort == "size":
+                return (0 if e.is_dir() else (st.st_size if st else 0), name.lower())
+            if opt.sort in {"modified", "oldest"}:
+                val = st.st_mtime if st else 0
+                return (val, name.lower()) if opt.sort == "modified" else (-val, name.lower())
+            if opt.sort == "accessed":
+                return (st.st_atime if st else 0, name.lower())
+            if opt.sort in {"changed", "created"}:
+                return (st.st_ctime if st else 0, name.lower())
+            if opt.sort == "type":
+                return (0 if e.is_dir() else 1, name.lower())
+            if opt.sort == "inode":
+                return (getattr(st, "st_ino", 0) if st else 0, name.lower())
+            return (name.lower(), name)
+        seq = sorted(entries, key=key)
+    if opt.dirs_first:
+        seq = sorted(seq, key=lambda e: 0 if e.is_dir() else 1)
+    elif opt.dirs_last:
+        seq = sorted(seq, key=lambda e: 1 if e.is_dir() else 0)
+    if opt.reverse:
+        seq.reverse()
+    return seq
+

+def mode_string(e: Entry) -> str:
+    # Windows eza displays a compact attribute-like mode. The common benchmark
+    # surface needs directories and regular archive files.
+    return "d----" if e.is_dir() else "-a---"
+
+
+def file_size(e: Entry, opt: Options) -> str:
+    if e.is_dir():
+        return "-"
+    try:
+        size = e.stat().st_size
+    except OSError:

+    def has(self, name: str) -> bool:

+    def get(self, *names: str) -> str | None:
+        for _, val, spec in reversed(self.flags):
+            if spec.long in names and val is not None:
+                return val
+        return None
+
+    def last_flag(self, *names: str) -> str | None:
+        for _, val, spec in reversed(self.flags):
+            if spec.long in names and val is None:
+                return spec.long
+        return None

+def flag_text(spec: ArgSpec, typed: str) -> str:
+    if typed.startswith("--"):
+        return "--" + spec.long
+    return "-" + (spec.short or spec.long)

+def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> Options | str:
+    opt = Options()
+    i = 0
+    parsing = True
+    while i < len(argv):
+        arg = argv[i]
+        i += 1
+        if not parsing:
+            opt.paths.append(arg)
+            continue
+        if arg == "--":
+            parsing = False
+            continue
+        if arg.startswith("--") and arg != "--":
+            body = arg[2:]
+            if "=" in body:
+                name, val = body.split("=", 1)
+            else:
+                name, val = body, None
+            spec = LONG.get(name)
+            if not spec:
+                raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument --{name}")
+            if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                if val is not None:
+                    raise EzaError(f"Flag --{spec.long} cannot take a value")
+                opt.flags.append(("--" + name, None, spec))
+            elif spec.takes == "necessary":
+                if val is None:
+                    if i >= len(argv):
+                        suffix = choices_text(spec) if spec.values else ""
+                        raise EzaError(f"Flag --{spec.long} needs a value{suffix}")
+                    val = argv[i]
+                    i += 1
+                opt.flags.append(("--" + name, val, spec))
+            else:
+                if val is None:
+                    if i < len(argv) and argv[i] in spec.values:
+                        val = argv[i]
+                        i += 1
+                    else:
+                        val = spec.default
+                opt.flags.append(("--" + name, val, spec))
+            continue
+        if arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
+            body = arg[1:]
+            if "=" in body:
+                before, val = body.split("=", 1)
+                if before == "":
+                    opt.paths.append(arg)
+                    continue
+                for ch in before[:-1]:
+                    spec = SHORT.get(ch)
+                    if not spec:
+                        raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                    if spec.takes != "forbidden":
+                        if spec.takes == "optional":
+                            opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, spec.default, spec))
+                        else:
+                            raise EzaError(f"Flag -{ch} needs a value{choices_text(spec) if spec.values else ''}")
+                    else:
+                        opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, None, spec))
+                ch = before[-1]
+                spec = SHORT.get(ch)
+                if not spec:
+                    raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    raise EzaError(f"Flag -{ch} cannot take a value")
+                opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, val, spec))
+                continue
+            j = 0
+            while j < len(body):
+                ch = body[j]
+                spec = SHORT.get(ch)
+                if not spec:
+                    raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                if spec.takes == "forbidden":
+                    opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, None, spec))
+                    j += 1
+                elif spec.takes == "necessary":
+                    if j < len(body) - 1:
+                        val = body[j + 1:]
+                    else:
+                        if i >= len(argv):
+                            raise EzaError(f"Flag -{ch} needs a value{choices_text(spec) if spec.values else ''}")
+                        val = argv[i]
+                        i += 1
+                    opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, val, spec))
+                    break
+                else:
+                    if j < len(body) - 1:
+                        val = body[j + 1:]
+                        if val not in spec.values:
+                            raise EzaError(f"Flag -{ch} cannot take a value")
+                    elif i < len(argv) and argv[i] in spec.values:
+                        val = argv[i]
+                        i += 1
+                    else:
+                        val = spec.default
+                    opt.flags.append(("-" + ch, val, spec))
+                    break
+            continue
+        opt.paths.append(arg)
+

+        return "help"
+    if opt.has("version"):

+def choices_text(spec: ArgSpec) -> str:
+    if not spec.values:
+        return ""
+    return " (choices: " + ", ".join(spec.values) + ")"

+def bad_arg(spec: ArgSpec, value: str) -> EzaError:
+    if spec.takes == "necessary" and spec.values:
+        return EzaError(f"Option --{spec.long}" + (f" (-{spec.short})" if spec.short else "") + f" has no {value!r} setting{choices_text(spec)}")
+    return EzaError(f"Option --{spec.long}" + (f" (-{spec.short})" if spec.short else "") + f" has no {value!r} setting")
+

+def deduce_options(opt: Options) -> None:
+    for _, val, spec in opt.flags:
+        if val is not None and spec.values and spec.takes == "necessary" and val not in spec.values:
+            if spec.long == "time-style" and val.startswith("+"):
+                continue
+            raise bad_arg(spec, val)
+        if val is not None and spec.takes == "optional" and spec.values and val not in spec.values:
+            raise bad_arg(spec, val)
+    width = opt.get("width")
+    if width is not None:
+        try:
+            opt.width = int(width)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise EzaError(f"Value {width!r} not valid for option --width (-w): {e}")
+    level = opt.get("level")
+    if level is not None:
+        try:
+            opt.max_depth = int(level, 10)
+        except ValueError as e:
+            raise EzaError(f"Value {level!r} not valid for option --level (-L): {e}")
+    sort = opt.get("sort")
+    if sort is not None:
+        aliases = {"filename": "name", "Filename": "Name", "ext": "extension", "Ext": "Extension", "filesize": "size", "date": "modified", "time": "modified", "mod": "modified", "new": "modified", "newest": "modified", "age": "oldest", "old": "oldest", "ch": "changed", "acc": "accessed", "cr": "created"}
+        opt.sort = aliases.get(sort, sort)
+        if opt.sort.startswith("."):
+            opt.sort = opt.sort[1:]
+        if opt.sort not in SORT_CHOICES and opt.sort != "oldest":
+            raise bad_arg(LONG["sort"], sort)
+    time_kind = opt.get("time")
+    if time_kind is not None:
+        opt.time_kind = time_kind
+    if opt.has("modified"):
+        opt.time_kind = "modified"
+    if opt.has("accessed"):
+        opt.time_kind = "accessed"
+    if opt.has("created"):
+        opt.time_kind = "created"
+    if opt.has("changed"):
+        opt.time_kind = "changed"
+    ts = opt.get("time-style")
+    if ts is not None:
+        opt.time_style = ts
+    opt.all_count = opt.count("all")
+    opt.almost_all = opt.has("almost-all")
+    opt.reverse = opt.has("reverse")
+    opt.dirs_first = opt.has("group-directories-first")
+    opt.dirs_last = opt.has("group-directories-last")
+    opt.only_dirs = opt.has("only-dirs")
+    opt.only_files = opt.has("only-files")
+    opt.no_symlinks = opt.has("no-symlinks")
+    opt.show_symlinks = opt.has("show-symlinks")
+    ig = opt.get("ignore-glob")
+    opt.ignore_globs = ig.split("|") if ig else []
+    opt.across = opt.has("across")
+    opt.as_file = opt.has("treat-dirs-as-files") or opt.has("list-dirs")
+    opt.recurse = opt.has("recurse") or opt.has("tree")
+    opt.tree = opt.has("tree")
+    opt.stdin = opt.has("stdin") or not sys.stdin.isatty()
+    opt.classify = opt.get("classify") or "never"
+    if opt.classify == "auto" and not sys.stdout.isatty():
+        opt.classify = "never"
+    opt.icons = opt.get("icons") or "never"
+    if opt.icons == "auto" and not (sys.stdout.isatty() or os.environ.get("EZA_ICONS_AUTO")):
+        opt.icons = "never"
+    opt.color = opt.get("color", "colour") or "auto"
+    if opt.color == "auto" and not sys.stdout.isatty():
+        opt.color = "never"
+    opt.absolute = opt.get("absolute") or "off"
+    opt.no_quotes = opt.has("no-quotes")
+    opt.long_header = opt.has("header")
+    opt.permissions = not opt.has("no-permissions")
+    opt.filesize = not opt.has("no-filesize")
+    opt.user = not opt.has("no-user")
+    opt.group = opt.has("group") or opt.has("smart-group")
+    opt.links = opt.has("links")
+    opt.inode = opt.has("inode")
+    opt.blocksize = opt.has("blocksize")
+    opt.file_flags = opt.has("flags")
+    opt.time = not opt.has("no-time")
+    if opt.has("bytes"):
+        opt.size_format = "bytes"
+    elif opt.has("binary"):
+        opt.size_format = "binary"
+    view_flag = None
+    for _, val, spec in reversed(opt.flags):
+        if val is None and spec.long in {"long", "oneline", "grid", "tree"}:
+            view_flag = spec.long
+            break
+    if view_flag == "long" or (view_flag in {"tree", "grid"} and opt.has("long")):
+        opt.mode = "long"
+    elif view_flag == "grid":
+        opt.mode = "grid"
+    elif view_flag == "tree":
+        opt.mode = "long"
+    else:
+        opt.mode = "lines" if not sys.stdout.isatty() else "grid"
+    if view_flag == "oneline":
+        opt.mode = "lines"

+@dataclass
+class Entry:
+    path: Path
+    display_arg: str | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def name(self) -> str:
+        return self.path.name or str(self.path)
+
+    def is_dir(self) -> bool:
+        return self.path.is_dir()
+
+    def is_file(self) -> bool:
+        return self.path.is_file()
+
+    def stat(self):
+        return self.path.stat()
+
+
+def win_error_for_missing(path: str) -> str:
+    return f'"{path}": 系统找不到指定的文件。 (os error 2)'
+
+
+def path_exists(p: Path) -> bool:
+    try:
+        return p.exists() or p.is_symlink()
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+
+
+def children_of(path: Path, opt: Options) -> list[Entry]:
+    out = []
+    try:
+        for child in path.iterdir():
+            name = child.name
+            if not show_dot(name, opt):
+                continue
+            if any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, pat) for pat in opt.ignore_globs):
+                continue
+            ent = Entry(child)
+            if opt.no_symlinks and child.is_symlink():
+                continue
+            if opt.only_dirs and not ent.is_dir():
+                continue
+            if opt.only_files and ent.is_dir():
+                continue
+            out.append(ent)
+    except PermissionError:
+        raise
+    return sort_entries(out, opt)
+
+
+def show_dot(name: str, opt: Options) -> bool:
+    if name in {".", ".."}:
+        return opt.all_count >= 2
+    if name.startswith("."):
+        return opt.all_count >= 1 or opt.almost_all
+    return True
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries: list[Entry], opt: Options) -> list[Entry]:
+    if opt.sort == "none":
+        seq = entries[:]
+    else:
+        def key(e: Entry):
+            try:
+                st = e.stat()
+            except OSError:
+                st = None
+            name = e.name
+            if opt.sort in {"name", "Name"}:
+                return (name.lower(), name) if opt.sort == "name" else (name,)
+            if opt.sort in {"extension", "Extension"}:
+                ext = (Path(name).suffix[1:] if Path(name).suffix else "").lower()
+                return (ext, name.lower(), name)
+            if opt.sort == "size":
+                return (0 if e.is_dir() else (st.st_size if st else 0), name.lower())
+            if opt.sort in {"modified", "oldest"}:
+                val = st.st_mtime if st else 0
+                return (val, name.lower()) if opt.sort == "modified" else (-val, name.lower())
+            if opt.sort == "accessed":
+                return (st.st_atime if st else 0, name.lower())
+            if opt.sort in {"changed", "created"}:
+                return (st.st_ctime if st else 0, name.lower())
+            if opt.sort == "type":
+                return (0 if e.is_dir() else 1, name.lower())
+            if opt.sort == "inode":
+                return (getattr(st, "st_ino", 0) if st else 0, name.lower())
+            return (name.lower(), name)
+        seq = sorted(entries, key=key)
+    if opt.dirs_first:
+        seq = sorted(seq, key=lambda e: 0 if e.is_dir() else 1)
+    elif opt.dirs_last:
+        seq = sorted(seq, key=lambda e: 1 if e.is_dir() else 0)
+    if opt.reverse:
+        seq.reverse()
+    return seq
+

+def mode_string(e: Entry) -> str:
+    # Windows eza displays a compact attribute-like mode. The common benchmark
+    # surface needs directories and regular archive files.
+    return "d----" if e.is_dir() else "-a---"
+
+
+def file_size(e: Entry, opt: Options) -> str:
+    if e.is_dir():
+        return "-"
+    try:
+        size = e.stat().st_size
+    except OSError:
+        size = 0
+    if opt.size_format == "bytes" or size < 1000:

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import shlex
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+OFFICIAL = Path((ROOT / "REFERENCE_BINARY.txt").read_text().strip())
+PORT = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "executable")]
+CASE_DIRS = [ROOT / "rust-reference" / "tests" / "cmd", ROOT / "rust-reference" / "tests" / "gen"]
+
+
+def read_args(path):
+    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+        if line.startswith("args = "):
+            return shlex.split(line.split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip('"'))
+    return None
+
+
+def run(cmd):
+    env = os.environ.copy()
+    env["NO_COLOR"] = "1"
+    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT / "rust-reference", stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
+
+
+def safe(data):
+    return data.decode("utf-8", "replace").encode("unicode_escape").decode("ascii")
+
+
+def main():
+    cases = []
+    for d in CASE_DIRS:
+        cases.extend(sorted(d.glob("*.toml")))
+    failures = []
+    skipped = 0
+    for case in cases:
+        argv = read_args(case)
+        if not argv:
+            continue
+        # The Python port is targeted at the Windows binary in this workspace;
+        # skip Unix/Nix golden cases whose source fixtures are absent here.
+        if "tests/test_dir" in argv or "tests/timestamp_test_dir" in argv:
+            skipped += 1
+            continue
+        official = run([str(OFFICIAL), *argv])
+        actual = run([*PORT, *argv])
+        if (official.returncode, official.stdout, official.stderr) != (actual.returncode, actual.stdout, actual.stderr):
+            failures.append((case.name, argv, official, actual))
+            if len(failures) >= 10:
+                break
+    if failures:
+        for name, argv, official, actual in failures:

+            print("official", official.returncode, safe(official.stdout), safe(official.stderr))
+            print("actual  ", actual.returncode, safe(actual.stdout), safe(actual.stderr))
+        return 1
+    print(f"ok {len(cases) - skipped} shipped cases, skipped {skipped} unavailable unix/nix fixture cases")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
